app.name: RANDOZ
home.tagline: Pool your photos with the people you're with. No accounts, nothing kept on a server.
home.promise: Photos travel directly between phones, encrypted. Leaving a group removes your photos from it.
groups.title: Your groups
groups.joiningHint: Looking for someone in the group. One of them needs RANDOZ open.
groups.refused: That invite is no longer valid. Ask for a new one.
welcome.title: Pick a group
welcome.hint: Choose a group on the left to see its photos, or start a new one.
start.title: Start a group
start.nameHint: Everyone who joins sees this name.
join.title: Join a group
join.scanHint: Point the camera at a RANDOZ invite code.
join.pasteEmpty: There's no invite link on the clipboard.
join.cameraDenied: RANDOZ needs the camera to scan a code. You can paste an invite link instead.
identity.title: Your identities
identity.intro: An identity is how you appear in a group: a name, a picture and a line about you. Pick one for each group, or stay random. There's no account behind them, but people who see the same identity in two groups will know it's you.
identity.none: No identities yet. Without one, each group gives you a random nickname, such as Blue Otter.
identity.name: Name
identity.aboutPlaceholder: The tall one in the red hat
identity.aboutHint: Optional. A short line people in the group see under your name.
identity.pictureHint: Optional. Without one, your initials are shown.
identity.confirmDeleteMessage: Groups that use it go back to a random nickname.
identity.randomHint: A nickname and colour made up for this group alone.
settings.stayHint: RANDOZ can stay connected while it's off the screen or the phone is locked, so photos keep arriving. Android shows a notification while it does, and it uses some battery.
settings.logHint: If something isn't arriving, this log helps work out why. It holds times and connection events, no photos or names.
prefs.title: Preferences
prefs.shareReminderHint: Reminds you who will see the photos before each share.
view.title: View and filter
sort.label: Sort by
sort.reverseHint: Oldest first, Z to A, or smallest first.
sort.title: Title
groupBy.label: Group by
filter.tag: Show photos tagged with any of
filter.noTags: No photo here has a tag yet. Open a photo and tap the pencil to add one.
filter.nothingHint: No photo in this group fits the search and filters.
details.title: Photo details
details.sharedNote: This is your photo, so everyone in the group sees what you write here.
details.privateNote: This is {name}'s photo. What you write here is for you alone: it replaces their title and description on this phone only.
tags.label: Tags
tags.hintShared: Tap a tag to add or remove it. Everyone in the group sees these.
tags.hintPrivate: Tap a tag to add or remove it. Only you see your tags.
groupDetails.title: Group details
groupDetails.sharedNote: You started this group, so everyone in it sees this name and description.
groupDetails.privateNote: A name and description of your own for this group, on this phone only. Leave them empty to use the ones its creator gave.
background.title: RANDOZ is connected
background.text: Photos keep arriving while it's in the background.
group.emptyHint: Share some of yours, or invite people to add theirs.
select.saved: Saved {count} photos to your camera roll
select.notAllYours: You can only unshare your own photos. Deselect the others first.
confirmShare.title: Share {count} photos?
confirmShare.message: Everyone in {group} will see them and can save them. Leaving the group removes them from RANDOZ, not from anyone's camera roll.
invite.title: Invite people
invite.kindOpenHint: Works for anyone who has it, until you turn it off. Safe to post in a group chat: it doesn't contain the group's key, and turning it off shuts the door.
invite.kindInPersonHint: A code that changes every minute, for people standing next to you. Coming in a later version.
invite.scanMe: Scan this in RANDOZ, or send the link.
invite.confirmOffMessage: Nobody new can join with it. People already in the group stay.
members.title: In this group
block.title: Block {name}?
block.message: They and everything they share disappear from this group on this phone, and nothing more of theirs is downloaded. Their photos already on this phone are deleted from RANDOZ; copies you saved to your camera roll stay. They aren't told, and they still see what you share. You can unblock them under Who's here.
block.listHint: Hidden on this phone only. They don't know.
viewer.saveDenied: RANDOZ needs permission to save to your camera roll.
viewer.waiting: Waiting for someone who has this photo to connect…
viewer.cantSave: You're not connected to anyone in this group, so the full-size photo can't be fetched. You can save it once someone who has it is online.
viewer.loadFailed: Couldn't fetch this photo. Its owner, or someone who has it, needs RANDOZ open.
viewer.confirmUnshareMessage: It disappears from everyone's gallery in RANDOZ. Copies people already saved to their camera roll stay with them.
leave.title: Leave {group}?
leave.message: Your photos disappear from everyone's gallery in RANDOZ, and the group is removed from this phone. Copies people already saved to their camera roll stay with them.
